subject.title: Steer mode does not inject messages mid-turn for main sessions

question: Should PR 89238 or a refreshed successor be the canonical path for ordinary same-session visible messages to bypass busy admission and reach active-run queue policy?
rationale: The remaining fix crosses message ordering, session-state ownership, and fallback/no-visible semantics, and the open candidate is conflicting with adjacent lifecycle work.

options.title: Refresh PR 89238
options.body: Rebase or replace PR 89238, preserve PR 98126 and PR 89045 behavior, and fix the no-visible fallback semantics before closing #48003.

options.title: Limit active steering to explicit controls
options.body: Keep only command/control-lane active steering for now and document that ordinary visible messages queue as follow-up turns until a broader admission design lands.

options.title: Split by channel owner
options.body: Create separate channel-specific follow-ups if Telegram, Discord, and WebChat need different ingress boundaries before active-run queue policy.

recommendation.title: Refresh PR 89238
recommendation.body: Rebase or replace PR 89238, preserve PR 98126 and PR 89045 behavior, and fix the no-visible fallback semantics before closing #48003.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged adjacent terminal-session recovery work that the remaining admission-layer fix must preserve.
